method.inventory_source: Frozen R07 package compiled knowledge manifest, compared with local registry by complete capability objects.
method.evidence_rule: Only exact completed MCP tool_name receipts count as callbacks. UI GET/proposal rendering/admin health and neighboring tools do not imply a callback. Semantic/effect acceptance requires the separate cited oracle/UI/human/ACK evidence.
method.negative_rule: No callback identified is an evidence gap in this enumerated review, not proof the capability was never used anywhere.

priority_blocks.why: These published mechanisms introduce owner-scoped memory, exact proposal reads and coordination of dependent drafts beyond a single financial change. Finance preview/status HTTP is not MCP proposals_get/operations_get, and a completed finance step is not workflow acceptance.
priority_blocks.bounded_next_read_only_intention: Read preferences_list plus proposals_get and operations_get for the exact already-owned historical financial proposal/execution. Obtain only their technical IDs with an authorized SQL oracle first; no new business effect or expected private values in the prompt.
priority_blocks.separate_positive_preparation: preferences_prepare and workflows_prepare need their own real callback/ready-or-clarification/proposal validation. Confirming an accepted memory or workflow effect requires the human channel on its exact revision/hash. Do not fabricate a preference or press the human button.
priority_blocks.scope_limit: One multi-tool intention can cover distinct common reads; it does not accept every helper or negative authority case.

priority_blocks.why: A GET/list total does not verify sum/filter/date/status/relationship semantics or distinguish totals from a paginated subset.
priority_blocks.bounded_next: Use one published finance_summaries operation restricted by existing own synthetic movement/filter fields, with a separate READ ONLY SQL sum/count oracle. Calendar/detail scenarios requiring a real house remain data-dependent; do not seed commercial rows merely to claim acceptance.
priority_blocks.reports_limit: Cross-module report tooling is not added to the 74 by this inventory; use only currently published exact capabilities.

priority_blocks.why: MCP issues a regenerable reference; authenticated download reauthorizes and materializes current bytes. A text callback, original attachment upload, or PNG/R2 proof does not test that protocol.
priority_blocks.bounded_next: One authorized CSV export on a chosen existing business: exact artifact reference/MIME/filename, GET download SHA/size against native export, and foreign or stale reference rejection without content exposure. invoices_file needs its own existing invoice/storage source; CSV does not accept R2 invoice retrieval.

priority_blocks.why: External reads cross SQL/outside-SQL/revalidation boundaries and may contend with the active Codex profile or resolve API credentials. Unknown/busy must remain explicit; session or model discovery never proves inference.
priority_blocks.bounded_next: Choose one read-only observation with independently available source and exact runtime scope; serialize account access and accept legitimate busy/unknown as a negative, not a green result. A same-profile Codex session/model check during its own active callback can hit intentional exclusion.
priority_blocks.credential_limit: Do not activate API inference, reveal keys, change provider/model, or use fallback to force a positive.

closure_limits: Four representative product-read positives cover exact cases, not every action/role/user/provider/financial/rental subfamily or the 74 individual capabilities.
Runtime availability/proofs are independently scoped and may invalidate after these historical receipts. This offline inventory is not an availability observation.
Cancel/revocation/uncertain reconciliation/compaction real subsets already have their own evidence. Do not reopen all C40-09 cases because older historical checklist text still says pending.

Direct O_EXCL contention and an HTTP/UI stop endpoint are not proven by the shared-journal contender test; the stop endpoint is proposed in contract41 and is not silently promoted to a newly approved epic.

PDF raw/audio unverified remain blocked; PDF reviewed-text and PNG/JPEG/WebP positives are distinct from product-tool coverage. Unsupported original modalities do not need fabricated transport to close a scoped Linux handoff.
Windows native, VPS/HTTPS/production, OpenAI API, OpenAI Web, other models/efforts/accounts, and the 77 unpublished candidates are outside this scoped Linux inventory.
This report does not close AI40, change plan45, approve draft documentation, or publish tools. The final 11-gate environment matrix and current deployment roundtrip are separate root-owned work.
